what: the independent adversary attack docs/HURRICANE_RI_PROGRAM.md ('Final') requires before the result is reported

attacked.claim: A (DTOPS raw, SHIPS-RII where DTOPS is missing), chosen on 2020-2024, beats SHIPS-RII, RIOC and v8.2 on the read-once 2025 season (paired storm-bootstrap 95% intervals on log loss and Brier exclude 0)

attacker: a separate agent with no part in producing the result; read-only on the repository; its scripts and logs a01-a08 were kept outside the repository
verdict: CONFIRMED, scoped to the 601-cycle case set
surviving_statement: On the 601 2025 NHC cycles whose archived e-deck holds a 30 kt / 24 h RIOD record (44 of the season's 53 truth-able tropical-cyclone RI events; Melissa's RI is absent from the archive), DTOPS raw beats SHIPS-RII, RIOC and v8.2 (both the model-C variant and the served artifact) on log loss and Brier, paired 95% storm-bootstrap intervals excluding 0.

log_loss_clip_eps_0p0005_to_0p05.note: A has 204 zero forecasts with 0 events there: the clip costs A, it does not help it; B has 2 events at 0%

weaknesses_to_state: Coverage: every development season's case set holds all truth-able TC RI events (53/53, 36/36, 36/36, 60/60, 48/48); 2025 holds 44 of 53. All 9 missing events (30 cycles) are Melissa AL132025: the archived e-deck eal132025.dat.gz has no line of any kind from 2025101918 to 2025102812. v8.2 on those 30 cycles: LL 0.565. With them added, A vs v8.2 still excludes 0 if DTOPS gave >= 20% at her event cycles, not if <= 5% (or <= 10% with non-event cycles >= 10%). NHC discussion #16 (5 AM EDT 25 Oct 2025) calls DTOPS 'quite aggressive, showing a very high probability of a 55-kt increase in intensity over the next 48 hours' -- consistent with the favourable side, but the 30 kt / 24 h values are not recoverable from the archive. Full-season A vs B and A vs C cannot be decided.
Effective sample: the 44 events come from 10 storms; Bonferroni over three comparisons (98.33%) leaves A-C dBrier at [-0.01728, -0.00020]; the log-loss intervals hold comfortably.

The 4,091/4,091 agreement with the v8.2 evaluation labels shares IBTrACS with our truth and the (SID, time) key: it verifies the dV arithmetic, not the e-deck -> storm mapping. The mapping is supported independently (e-deck position vs fix: median 11 km; 2025 max 94.6 km; the attacker's own parse).
'v8.2' in the final is the benchmark's model C (members <= 2018, calibration 2019-2021), not the served artifact; the claim holds for both (numbers above).

Protocol text error: candidate E's note that 'no development season is in-sample' for model C is false -- its calibration window 2019-2021 contains the development seasons 2020-2021. It affects only E's training rows; E was not chosen.

Process: a 20-draw wiring smoke of the select phase computed the pooled development metrics two minutes before the official select (same script and protocol bytes, so no second decision path); the final started 22 s after the one-string script edit; fetch_and_score.py (on v8.2's live-builder import path) was edited after the final -- parity of the v8.2 inputs rests on the dev-table sha guard and the attacker's 601/601 reproduction.

whether archived e-decks equal the real-time SHIPS text: the 2026 e-decks, once archived, against the 2026 SHIPS text (the protocol's own pending check)
